findings.text: HIGHEST_DIFFERENCE_COLOR registers a figure hue as a bare hex literal in the prototype, while nova/media/ink.py:3 declares InkStyle the single place every visual constant lives, so this magenta can drift from the house palette with no test to catch it; the node's fence excluded nova/media/ink.py, so the repair is a separate node adding the constant to InkStyle and reading it here.

assert_array_equal(target.coordinate, coordinate) compares the coordinate the builder handed to build_flux_blocks with the coordinate it attached to the same target, so both sides come from the code under test and move together; a builder that switched to the hybrid kernel while reusing that coordinate would still satisfy it, and only the row comparison at :81-85 is an independent guard.
